title: MoodMeme
tagline: MoodMeme: AI-powered Telegram bot that generates hilarious crypto memes using real-time market data. Drop a token name, get back a perfectly timed meme with snarky AI captions. Plus, compete for the "Most Roasted Token" crown! 🎭 #CryptoMemes #AI
description:
MoodMeme is a Telegram bot that transforms crypto market sentiment into instant meme magic. Here's what makes it special:

Real-time Meme Generation: Users simply type /meme [token] (e.g., "Bitcoin" or "ETH") and the bot instantly creates a custom meme using live market data.
Smart Context: The bot analyzes current price movements, trading volume, and market trends to generate perfectly timed, contextually relevant memes.
AI-Powered Humor: Using Gaia's AI capabilities, each meme comes with a witty caption that perfectly captures the market moment, complete with crypto slang and community inside jokes.
Viral Features:


Auto-watermarking with "Made by @MoodMemeBot"
"Tag 3 friends to roast" prompt encourages sharing
Leaderboard tracking "most roasted" tokens
Weekly meme battles between trending tokens


Community Engagement:


Real-time price data ensures memes are always relevant
Shared experiences during market volatility create community bonds
Competitive element through leaderboards keeps users coming back
how_its_made:
Built using the Collab.Land Starter Kit, MoodMeme combines blockchain data with AI-powered meme generation. The backend uses Express.js and Node.js, integrating Gaia AI for witty captions and CoinGecko API for real-time crypto data. The Telegram bot interface (built with Telegraf) lets users generate memes with a simple command. When a user requests a meme, the system:

Fetches current market data
Generates a contextual caption using Gaia AI
Creates the meme using Imgflip API
Adds a viral watermark
Tracks engagement in a leaderboard system

All components run on the starter kit's infrastructure, with TypeScript ensuring type safety and MongoDB handling data persistence.
